npc_1.1.name: NPC
npc_1.1.text: Climb and you'll get the answers to your questions.

npc_1.2.name: NPC
npc_1.2.text: Welcome to the second level of the 1st floor.

npc_1.3.name: NPC
npc_1.3.text: The last level, im surprised you made it.

npc_1.3.name: NPC
npc_1.3.text: Go back to the 1st level, go towards the left side of the map.

npc_1.3.name: NPC
npc_1.3.text: I'm pretty sure you already saw it, but can't reach it.

npc_1.3.name: NPC
npc_1.3.text: Go back, after you reached the next floor.

npc_2.2.name: NPC
npc_2.2.text: You, Yes, find and go near the light, it will open the way for you later

npc_2.2.name: NPC
npc_2.2.text: Right now find the exit, memorize the pattern to light your way out

npc_2.2.name: NPC
npc_2.2.text: I bet on you, that you will reach all the way to the 3rd floor.

npc_2.3.name: NPC
npc_2.3.text: Money, the sweet smeel of money, I knew I'd get my worth in you

npc_2.3.name: NPC
npc_2.3.text: Go back at the 1st level in this floor, use your shine ability near the exit.

npc_3.1.name: NPC
npc_3.1.text: I see you are familiar with the sword, burn brightly soldier..

npc_3.1.name: NPC
npc_3.1.text: To move to the next level, defeat the guardian, his powers are blocking the way out.

npc_3.2.name: NPC
npc_3.2.text: Steel your mind, you'll get through this.

npc_3.2.name: NPC
npc_3.2.text: Defeat the guardian at the end, you will get what you need and also lead to the last challenge.
